taxon.note: Scientific and common names (and USDA symbol, where given) as the spec's authors wrote them, and the genus the scientific name is written in.

growth_form.note: The growth form the spec's authors chose from the plant's habit.

growth.note: The growth plan (years, step, keyframes) chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

variants.note: The environments, conditions and seeds chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

taxon.family.note: WCVP v16's family for the accepted name.

taxon.plant_name_id.note: WCVP v16's plant_name_id for the accepted species the name resolves to (the accepted name).

generator.params.note: Kept from the template, Viola glabella, except: stems 4 (Flora of North America vol. 6, Viola adunca: stems 1-5); one basal leaf at each stem's foot, 9 cm long with its stalk (basal leaves 1-4, petiole 0.5-13.5 cm, blade 0.5-6.9 cm); the stem leaf card 6 cm, blade and stalk (cauline blade 0.6-5.5 cm, petiole 0.5-6.5 cm); the flower's stalk 5 cm (peduncles 1.7-13.8 cm). flower_size is left to the rule from flower_size_m, and stem_height to the rule from height_typical_m. The shading areas are the template's, for the shading test to correct. Not fitted to measurements.

allometry.note: 0.15 m tall at 4 years in the open, inside Flora of North America's 1.8-30(-35) cm and the model estimate's usual 5-15 cm. Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.

appearance.note: Bark and leaf colours the template's (no source read colours the leaves). Flower from Flora of North America vol. 6, Viola adunca (read on eFloras, 2026-10-18): petals 'light- to deep- to lavender-violet on both surfaces', drawn a mid lavender-violet; accent dark violet for 'dark violet-veined'. The leaf card's stalk share is left to the rule from petiole_length_m.

appearance.organs.basal.shape.note: Flora of North America vol. 6 (2015), Viola adunca (read on eFloras, 2026-10-18): basal petiole 0.5-13.5 cm, blade 0.5-6.9 cm, so the stalk is about two thirds of a basal leaf's length at the ranges' middles (0.65).

appearance.organs.flower.shape.note: The template's flower (two upper petals, two side ones and the lowest spurred). The spur's length is left to the rule from spur_length_m.

traits.height_typical_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 6 (2015), Viola adunca (read on eFloras, 2026-10-18): plants 1.8-30(-35) cm. The typical 10 cm is the model estimate's usual 5-15 cm (species-facts-2026-10-15, record L2464126).

traits.height_max_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 6 (2015), Viola adunca (read on eFloras, 2026-10-18): plants 1.8-30(-35) cm.

traits.life_span.note: Flora of North America vol. 6 (2015), Viola adunca (read on eFloras, 2026-10-18): plants perennial.

traits.woodiness.note: A model estimate (confidence high, record L2464126), as no source read gives it.

traits.leaf_habit.note: A model estimate (confidence high, record L2464126), as no source read gives it.

traits.perennation.note: Flora of North America vol. 6 (2015), Viola adunca (read on eFloras, 2026-10-18): stems on caudex from subligneous rhizome.

traits.stem_posture.note: Flora of North America vol. 6 (2015), Viola adunca (read on eFloras, 2026-10-18): stems 1-5, erect, ascending, or decumbent, sometimes later reclining to nearly prostrate.

traits.leaf_arrangement.note: A model estimate (confidence high, record L2464126), as no source read gives it.

traits.cauline_leaves.note: Flora of North America vol. 6 (2015), Viola adunca (read on eFloras, 2026-10-18): leaves basal and cauline; cauline similar to basal except stipule margins lacerate to laciniate.

traits.leaf_shape.note: Flora of North America vol. 6 (2015), Viola adunca (read on eFloras, 2026-10-18): blade usually ovate or ovate-deltate to ovate-orbiculate, sometimes ± reniform or oblong, base cordate, subcordate, truncate, or attenuate.

traits.leaf_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 6 (2015), Viola adunca (read on eFloras, 2026-10-18): basal blade 0.5-6.9 × 0.4-5 cm; cauline blade 0.6-5.5 × 0.4-4.7 cm.

traits.leaf_width_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 6 (2015), Viola adunca (read on eFloras, 2026-10-18): basal blade 0.5-6.9 × 0.4-5 cm.

traits.petiole_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 6 (2015), Viola adunca (read on eFloras, 2026-10-18): cauline petiole 0.5-6.5 cm (basal petiole 0.5-13.5 cm, drawn on the basal card).

traits.leaf_margin.note: Flora of North America vol. 6 (2015), Viola adunca (read on eFloras, 2026-10-18): margins crenate to crenulate or entire, ciliate or eciliate.

traits.leaf_apex.note: Flora of North America vol. 6 (2015), Viola adunca (read on eFloras, 2026-10-18): apex acute to obtuse.

traits.inflorescence.note: A model estimate (confidence high, record L2464126), as no source read gives it in words; Flora of North America gives each flower its own peduncle.

traits.peduncle_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 6 (2015), Viola adunca (read on eFloras, 2026-10-18): peduncles 1.7-13.8 cm, glabrous or puberulent.

traits.flower_size_m.note: A model estimate (confidence high, record L2464126), as no source read gives it.

traits.petal_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 6 (2015), Viola adunca (read on eFloras, 2026-10-18): lowest petal 7-17(-23) mm.

traits.spur_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 6 (2015), Viola adunca (read on eFloras, 2026-10-18): spur purple to violet or white, elongated, 5-7 mm, tip straight or pointed, curved up or lateral.

traits.flower_colour.note: Flora of North America vol. 6 (2015), Viola adunca (read on eFloras, 2026-10-18): petals light- to deep- to lavender-violet on both surfaces, rarely white. The colour is our reading of the words.

traits.perianth_base_colour.note: Flora of North America vol. 6 (2015), Viola adunca (read on eFloras, 2026-10-18): lower 3 [petals] usually white basally, dark violet-veined. The drawing whitens every petal's base, not only the lower three's.

traits.flower_symmetry.note: A model estimate (confidence high, record L2464126), as no source read gives it; Flora of North America's spurred lowest petal and bearded lateral pair agree.

traits.sexual_system.note: A model estimate (confidence high, record L2464126), as no source read gives it.

traits.fruit_type.note: Flora of North America vol. 6 (2015), Viola adunca (read on eFloras, 2026-10-18): capsules short-ovoid, 6-11 mm, glabrous.

traits.fruit_shape.note: Flora of North America vol. 6 (2015), Viola adunca (read on eFloras, 2026-10-18): capsules short-ovoid.

traits.fruit_size_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 6 (2015), Viola adunca (read on eFloras, 2026-10-18): capsules 6-11 mm.

traits.fruit_colour_ripe.note: A model estimate (confidence high, record L2464126: brown), as no source read gives it.

traits.flowering_months.note: A model estimate (confidence high, record L2464126), as no source read gives it.

traits.fruiting_months.note: A model estimate (confidence high, record L2464126), as no source read gives it.

provenance.notes: Procedural proxy (core expansion batch A1, 2026-10-18) from the Viola glabella template, its traits from Flora of North America and, where no source read gives them, the model estimates of species-facts-2026-10-15. Calibration against measurements and photographs is milestone P4.
